description: This PHP source file handles the display and processing of test case search results within the TestLink project management system. It includes functions for initializing search parameters, building result tables, and managing search filters based on user input.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering templates.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Class for building and managing external tables in the UI.

methods.name: buildExtTable
methods.description: Constructs a table of test case search results with links for editing and viewing history.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes search parameters from user input.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI state and default values for the search page.

methods.name: initSearch
methods.description: Populates GUI filters and options based on the current test project configuration.
